review_note: Independent comparison against pinned original statement retained in Stage A sites.tex:8962; no proof or unsafe source viewed. A natural transformation t:u'→u of set-valued functors on C induces a compatible transformation of stalk functors F_{p'}→F_p. Its restriction to stalks of representables recovers t via the stated prior lemma; the arrow direction remains u'→u.
statement:
Let $\mathcal{C}$ be a site.
Let $u, u' : \mathcal{C} \to \textit{Sets}$ be two
functors, and let $t : u' \to u$ be a transformation of functors.
Then we obtain a canonical transformation of stalk
functors $t_{stalk} : \mathcal{F}_{p'} \to \mathcal{F}_p$
which agrees with $t$ via the identifications of
Lemma \ref{lemma-points-recover}.

original_source_statement_tex:
\label{lemma-maps-u-points}
Let $\mathcal{C}$ be a site.
Let $u, u' : \mathcal{C} \to \textit{Sets}$ be two
functors, and let $t : u' \to u$ be a transformation of functors.
Then we obtain a canonical transformation of stalk
functors $t_{stalk} : \mathcal{F}_{p'} \to \mathcal{F}_p$
which agrees with $t$ via the identifications of
Lemma \ref{lemma-points-recover}.
